items.name: factory-floor-oil-a
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated transparent top-down floor decal for a hand-painted children's toy factory game. Strict orthographic overhead view, no perspective. Muted believable industrial wear, painterly brush texture, subtle irregular edges. This is only the stain/scuff itself with genuine transparent alpha around it and within sparse gaps, no drawn floor, no rectangle, no background colour, no shadow, no text, no border, no interface. Leave generous fully transparent padding on every edge, all marks fully inside canvas. Primary request: one modest asymmetrical round oil spill with three small nearby droplets. Dark warm umber and charcoal centre, muted slate-teal oily sheen on one small area, low-key soft edges, mostly translucent thinner rim. Broad compact organically scalloped silhouette, a little faded rubbed edge. Square canvas. Do not render shiny raised liquid or a hole; it lies flat.
